D/ IMP M AVREL ANTONINVS AVG ; R/ PROV DEOR TRP XVI COS III

Silver coin. Denarius of Marcus Aurelius (139-180); the finder kindly cites Sear no. 1417, issue of 161-162, mint of Rome, RIC vol. 3 page 279 no. 833. Obverse description: Bare shouldered and bare headed bust right, tightly curled hair and beard. Obverse inscription: IMP M AVREL ANTONINVS AVG. Reverse description: Draped figure standing left cradling cornucopiae and holding globe in outstretched…
